newsitem.title: USA: Lands' End to sell stake in Territory Ahead.
newsitem.headline: Lands' End to sell stake in Territory Ahead.

text.p: Lands' End Inc. said Thursday it reached a preliminary agreement to sell its majority interest in The Territory Ahead, another catalogue retailer.

It said it would sell the stake to Bruce Willard, founder, president and chief executive of the Santa Barbara, Calif.-based company, which sells private-label sportswear, accessories and luggage. Terms of the deal were not released.
Lands' End said Territory Ahead's annual sales have grown to about $30 million this year from around $6 million when it purchased its majority interest in March 1993.

"We have decided to divest ourselves of (Territory Ahead) at this time because Bruce wants to take (Territory Ahead) in some new directions, and we want to concentrate our efforts on expanding the Lands' End brand in various areas," Michael Smith, president of Dodgevill, Wis.-based Lands' End, said in a statement.
Willard said Territory Ahead planned to expand into the retail business over the next couple of years.
The sale will close within three months if all conditions in the letter of intent are met, Lands' End said.
